description: This is a Java interface named Customizable that defines methods for classes that can have custom attributes added by users, such as Visit entities in the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: Customizable
classes.description: A marker interface for classes that can be customized with user-added attributes. It declares methods for retrieving all attributes, active attributes, and adding new attributes.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns all attributes, including voided ones.

methods.name: getActiveAttributes
methods.description: Returns non-voided attributes of a specific type, filtered by CustomValueDescriptor.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds a new attribute to the object.
